title: 쌀 포장 읽기: 언제 도정했어요? 몇 kg이에요?
objective: By the end, you can find the harvest year, milling date, weight, grade, and origin on a Korean rice bag. You can also tell how to store the rice.
summary: Learners read the information label on a Korean rice bag and find the dates, weight, grade, origin, and storage tips.
note: The label above is a sample. The brand name and the phone number are made up.

task.title: Read rice bag labels
task.line: Use the words in Part 2 and the tips in Part 3 to find, choose, or fill in the answer.

sections.heading: Part 1. 쌀 포장 뒷면 (Back of a rice bag)
paragraphs: 도정일: 2026.10.05 | 중량: 10kg | 등급: 상 | 원산지: 국산
보관 방법: 햇빛을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하세요.

items.text: Tells you what the product is.
The kind of rice. 혼합 means different kinds are mixed together.
The year the rice was grown and harvested. It shows only a year.
items.example: 이 쌀은 언제 생산했어요? 생산연도를 보세요.

items.text: The day the rice was milled (polished). It shows a full date.
How heavy the rice in the bag is.
The quality level: 특 (top), 상 (high), 보통 (standard).
Where the rice was grown. 국산 means grown in Korea.
Tells you where to keep the rice: usually a cool place (서늘한 곳), away from sunlight (햇빛).
items.example: 쌀을 사면 보관 방법을 꼭 읽으세요.

items.text: Rice harvested this year. You often see this word on bags in the fall.

sections.heading: Part 3. Reading tip: two dates
paragraphs: 생산연도 and 도정일 look alike, but they are different. 생산연도 shows only a year (2026년), and 도정일 shows a full date. Many people check 도정일 first because freshly milled rice tastes better.
Dates are often written with dots: 2026.10.05 = 2026년 10월 5일.

exercises: Find the milling date on this label. Write it in Korean: 생산연도: 2025년 / 도정일: 2026.10.02 / 중량: 5kg
Choose the best grade: 보통 / 특 / 상
Today is in October 2026. Is this rice 햅쌀? Write Yes or No: ① 생산연도: 2026년 ② 생산연도: 2025년
Fill in the blank with one word from Part 2: 한국 쌀이에요. ____는 국산이에요.
Is this a good place to keep rice? Write Yes or No: ① 햇빛이 많은 창문 옆 ② 서늘하고 어두운 곳
You live alone and want a small, light bag of rice. Choose one: 가) 중량 20kg 나) 중량 4kg
